# Lidar Pod LP-3

The Lidar Pod LP-3 is an airborne laser scanner that hangs under a light
aircraft and measures ground height to a few centimetres. It is made by
[[velloria-optics]] and stored at [[brask-station]].

## Calibration

The pod is calibrated before every flight campaign, and at least every ten
flights.
